basis: Independent canonical ?dir=b Discovery opens at week 7 and naturally wheels to 0. Desktop and portrait 0→14→0 show a foundation plan and authored programme texture on the ground, with the same house assembled above it. Pinned view.js drawSheet updates a cached base canvas at the virtual week; autoShotForWeek changes top→b2→b3→top. At 13.5–14 no PHASES row is active, so HUD falls back to Site Mobilisation until the exact week-14 completion branch. Interior stops are offered as tabs but the automatic B route returns overhead; no automatic five-stop tour is claimed.

milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: The foundation plan and fourteen-week programme are printed on the ground; site set-up and early excavation overlap above the same plan.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: Excavation and its temporary work occur inside the foundation footprint while the on-ground programme cursor advances.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: Pad footings, ring beam and slab develop over the matching drawn foundation geometry.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: The camera has moved to the oblique B3 view and timber portal frames rise, with future work still visible as ghost outlines.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: The CLT mezzanine and stair enter the frame as the adjacent phase bars fill on the site sheet.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: Wall cassettes replace some ghost outlines, retaining the one-house geometry above the printed programme.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: Roof cassettes and standing-seam surface close the same structure under the crane.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: Glazing and doors occupy the intended openings while the week line advances across the paper programme.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: Exterior cladding and internal finishes cover the assembled shell; sheet and HUD still track one virtual week.

milestones.label: M10
milestones.observedChange: Furniture and handover pieces arrive after the finishes, with room tabs becoming available near the end.

milestones.label: M11
milestones.observedChange: After the last authored phase ends at week 13.5, automatic camera returns overhead and the HUD wrongly says Site Mobilisation on a near-complete house.

milestones.label: M12
milestones.observedChange: At week 14 the overhead view shows the completed house over the plan, filled programme bars and Practical Completion text.

reverseSemanticStates: The overhead complete sheet reverses through the oblique staged build, ghost future pieces, structure and ground work back to the initial plan at virtual week zero. The late-phase Site Mobilisation fallback can reappear in reverse; the canonical B route does not auto-enter the five-stop interior.
